events.description: The video opens at Old Trafford, highlighting the Soccer Aid event as it marks the first appearance in three years.
events.title: Opening at Old Trafford

events.description: Bobby Williams, Harry Redknapp, Vicky McClure, Robbie Williams and Zavon Hines appear, marking their return after last year's Soccer Aid.
events.title: Williams Redknapp McClure return

events.description: Maisie Adam, who married yesterday, gives the ball away early in the match while Bobby Williams, Harry Redknapp and Vicky McClure watch.
events.title: Maisie Adam gives ball away

events.description: Ben Foster fails to stop a shot, giving England a lead, while Francesco Totti, Hernán Crespo and David James are shown on screen.
events.title: Foster beaten, England leads

events.description: Francesco Totti, Hernán Crespo and David James appear as England leads 2-1.

events.description: The match highlights a £750 donation to Unicef while referencing Totti, Crespo and David James.

events.description: Brian McFadden is praised for raising £11,000 for Unicef during the show.

events.title: Stormzy comments on Paul Scholes' halftime situation

events.title: Paul Scholes scores; Redknapp, Stormzy, Cove react

events.description: Tom Grant delivers a brilliant ball, Leon tries to knock it out but it falls short, setting up a chance for Paul Scholes.

events.title: England goes 2‑1 up with outside‑foot strike

events.description: Robbie Keane is highlighted as the action returns to him following England's 2‑1 advantage.
events.title: Robbie Keane praised after England's 2‑1 lead

events.description: Mauricio Pochettino and Melanie C appear as Robbie Keane notes the Irish side has leveled the match.
events.title: Pochettino, Melanie C and Keane see Ireland level

events.description: Robbie King scores an absolute screamer, bringing World XI level with England at 2-2.
events.title: Robbie King scores screamer

events.title: Martin Compston stays fit Edwards quick

events.description: Edwards rushes out, Cahill clears the ball, and Bobby Keen strikes again after the rebound.
events.title: Cahill clears Bobby Keen strikes

events.description: After Cahill's clearance and Bobby Keen's strike, World XI scores to go ahead 3-2 against England.
events.title: World XI takes lead via Cahill

events.description: Robbie Keane delivers a lovely pass to Noah, setting up World XI's latest goal.
events.title: Robbie Keane assists Noah

events.description: After the Irishman's dink, Embrace finishes the play and celebrates the goal.
events.title: Irishman dinks, Embrace celebrates

events.description: Embrace is highlighted as the player who finishes the move and celebrates the outcome.
events.title: Embrace celebrates finish

events.description: Embrace states that he absolutely loves being involved in Soccer Aid every single year.
events.title: Embrace expresses love for Soccer Aid

events.description: Chuck sees the action, Force throws his head at the ball, producing a quick reaction.
events.title: Chuck reacts, Force heads ball

events.description: Following the best touch, the ball runs loose and is carried away by a player.
events.title: Ball carried loose after touch

events.description: The player has five on his mind, aiming to finish the play and secure the record, with Ken likely to win.
events.title: Ken eyes record, aims for win

events.description: Ken Saturday is identified as the player who has scored the most goals in Soccer Aid history.
events.title: Ken Saturday tops Soccer Aid scoring

events.description: Ken Saturday is announced as the new highest goal scorer in Soccer Aid and expresses delight at the achievement.
events.title: Ken Saturday named top scorer

events.description: Ken Saturday scores a lovely goal, getting past Dutch legend Clarence, and his performance is praised.
events.title: Ken Saturday scores past Clarence

events.description: After a loose pass by Mo Farah, Ken Saturday scores past Clarence, finishing a strong run.
events.title: Ken Saturday goal after Farah pass

events.title: Ken Saturday scores past Paddy McGinnis

events.description: Ken Saturday states that what he really wants is victory after scoring the goal.
events.title: Ken Saturday desires victory

events.title: Thank Players and Staff
